$comment: Predictable Revenue — evidence rules. Focus: confidence modulation on demand/pipeline/follow-up. Tier-1 for those that can be evaluated from full ledger/transcript.

evidence_rules.condition: evidence menunjukkan prospek/inquiry MASUK (ada yang menghubungi/menjawab) TETAPI tidak ada jejak tindak lanjut dalam transkrip (tidak ada mention follow-up, balasan, jadwal ketemu)
evidence_rules.matcher_hint: The user RECOUNTS incoming interest (inquiry, DM, lead, 'ada yang tanya') but the transcript shows NO subsequent action taken on it — the lead is mentioned once and never revisited.

consequence.rationale: Demand sudah sampai ke pintu tapi bocor di follow-up = sinyal C6.4 kuat (bukan DM5.1). Menaikkan C6.4 penting agar intervensi mengarah ke response system, bukan acquisition.

evidence_rules.evaluation_note: Rule RAISE (not LOWER) — PR is a rare source of positive confirmation for C6.4, which has so far had zero knowledge. The matcher must be strict: inquiry WITHOUT follow-up; if there is follow-up, do not match.

evidence_rules.condition: user mengklaim 'sedang fokus menjual / lagi rame' TIDAK disertai angka outreach proaktif mingguan apa pun dalam 2 minggu terakhir
evidence_rules.matcher_hint: The user RECOUNTS being busy selling or hustling, BUT when numbers are probed there is NO countable proactive outreach activity (calls, emails, DMs, offers sent) in the recent period — activity exists only as identity claim, not behavior.

consequence.rationale: Klaim aktivitas tanpa bukti perilaku tidak boleh menurunkan DM5.1 — demand problem tetap hidup sampai outreach terukur ada (selaras disiplin bukti TM-R01: intention ≠ evidence).

evidence_rules.condition: evidence transkrip memuat angka outreach/ kontak baru ≥ threshold dalam minggu berjalan, disitasi eksplisit oleh user
evidence_rules.matcher_hint: The user RECOUNTS a concrete count of NEW prospects contacted this week or a consistent recent streak (e.g. 'minggu ini kirim 15 penawaran', 'tiap hari DM 5 orang').

consequence.rationale: Outreach aktif terukur = distribution inactivity menurun. LOWER DS4.2 agar sumber daya diagnosis tidak salah arah ke distribusi.

evidence_rules.evaluation_note: Predicate hanya mendeteksi BAHASAN outreach — apakah angkanya cukup tetap judgment LLM di tahap probe. Tier-1 dipilih agar sitasi kata kunci wajib (anti-halusinasi), bukan untuk mengukur volume.

evidence_rules.condition: user menjalankan semua tahap (cari prospek, balas, closing, delivery) sendiri DAN mengeluh tidak sempat / selalu kalah prioritas oleh pekerjaan lain
evidence_rules.matcher_hint: The user RECOUNTS doing every sales role alone AND complains time is consumed by delivery or urgent work so prospecting never happens — classic solo founder no-specialization pattern.

consequence.rationale: PR: tanpa pemisahan role/blok waktu, prospek selalu kalah oleh 'urgent' — structural inactivity, bukan masalah keinginan. Intervensi = sistem blok waktu, bukan motivasi.

evidence_rules.condition: target prospek tidak difilter kriteria (semua orang dihubungi) DAN response rate dikeluhkan rendah
evidence_rules.matcher_hint: The user RECOUNTS contacting anyone and everyone (no ICP filter, no list criteria) AND complains that almost nobody responds.

consequence.rationale: Low response pada list tak terfilter bisa disalahartikan sebagai 'pasar sepi' (DM5.1). FLAG M3.1 agar diagnosis membedakan demand problem vs targeting problem sebelum menambah volume.

evidence_rules.evaluation_note: Dipilih FLAG_SEGMENT (bukan RAISE) karena perlu konfirmasi definisi ICP via probe PR-P03 sebelum yakin M3.1 — buka jalur pembeda DM5.1 vs M3.1.

evidence_rules.condition: A numeric bridge exists between the stated goal and the weekly outbound/inquiry activity that is supposed to produce it.
evidence_rules.matcher_hint: The user RECOUNTS breaking an annual revenue goal down into weekly activity math — number of conversations × conversion rate × average deal size — and tracking against it.

consequence.rationale: Pipeline math (Predictable Revenue) mengubah tujuan ambigu menjadi jalur terukur per minggu — path ambiguity turun.

evidence_rules.condition: Actual volume is being counted and compared to the required pipeline, not just outcomes.
evidence_rules.matcher_hint: The user RECOUNTS tracking weekly prospecting/inquiry volume (conversations held, inquiries received) against the pipeline volume the revenue gap requires.

consequence.rationale: Demand insufficiency hanya bisa didiagnosis dengan mengukur volume aktivitas vs gap — tanpa angka ini, kekurangan pipeline tak terlihat.

evidence_rules.condition: Outreach is aimed at non-decision-makers; volume of activity cannot convert because authority is missing.
evidence_rules.matcher_hint: The user RECOUNTS prospecting or pitching people who cannot buy — students of the service, employees without budget authority, or contacts outside the defined ICP.

consequence.rationale: Volume ke orang yang salah (bukan decision-maker ICP) = rejection tanpa pembelajaran — inti Authority Mismatch.

evidence_rules.condition: One person performs delivery plus acquisition; scaling either side is structurally capped by their hours.
evidence_rules.matcher_hint: The user RECOUNTS the founder personally handling BOTH delivery AND all sales work at the same time, with no specialized roles.

consequence.rationale: Spesialisasi peran (prospector/closer/delivery terpisah) adalah prasyarat skala — founder jalan dua arah menandai kapasitas delivery mentok.
